description: Na₄MgV₂O₆ crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.64 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.59 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with four equivalent VO₅ trigonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent MgO₅ trigonal bipyramids, and edges with two equivalent VO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.23-2.38 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.21-2.48 Å. Mg is bonded to five O atoms to form MgO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with four equivalent VO₅ trigonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids, and edges with two equivalent VO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.07-2.20 Å. There are two inequivalent V sites. In the first V site, V is bonded to five O atoms to form VO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with four equivalent MgO₅ trigonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids, and edges with two equivalent VO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.96-2.17 Å. In the second V site, V is bonded to five O atoms to form VO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with four equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent MgO₅ trigonal bipyramids, and edges with two equivalent VO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.94-2.20 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Mg, and one V atom to form distorted ONa₃MgV trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent ONa₃MgV₂ octahedra, corners with six ONa₃MgV₂ pentagonal pyramids,  an edgeedge with one ONa₃MgV₂ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₄V₂ pentagonal pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 41-76°. In the second O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Mg, and two V atoms to form distorted ONa₃MgV₂ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one ONa₄V₂ pentagonal pyramid, corners with two equivalent ONa₃MgV trigonal bipyramids, edges with three ONa₃MgV₂ pentagonal pyramids,  an edgeedge with one ONa₃MgV trigonal bipyramid, and  a faceface with one ONa₃MgV₂ pentagonal pyramid. In the third O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Mg, and two V atoms to form distorted ONa₃MgV₂ pentagonal pyramids that share corners with three equivalent ONa₄V₂ pentagonal pyramids, corners with four equivalent ONa₃MgV trigonal bipyramids,  an edgeedge with one ONa₃MgV₂ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one ONa₄V₂ pentagonal pyramid, and  a faceface with one ONa₃MgV₂ octahedra. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to four Na and two V atoms to form distorted ONa₄V₂ pentagonal pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one ONa₃MgV₂ octahedra, corners with three equivalent ONa₃MgV₂ pentagonal pyramids, corners with two equivalent ONa₃MgV trigonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent ONa₃MgV₂ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one ONa₃MgV₂ pentagonal pyramid, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₃MgV trigonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 47°. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mg, and two V atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na, one Mg, and one V atom.
